WITH first_version AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id, join_date
  FROM dim_member
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) = 1
)
SELECT f.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, count(DISTINCT f.member_id) AS new_members
FROM first_version f
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = f.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE f.join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
  AND f.home_store_id <> 999
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
